SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
S.1, Special Branch Station,
Date ____ March __ 24 __ , 34

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. File No. REGISTER / No. D 5756 / Date 24 / 3 / 34）

Subject (in full) .... Dispute between a Chinese policeman and a French
employee of the C.M.F. over the jurisdiction of
extra-Settlement road.

Made by .. D.I. .. Sih Tse-liang .... Forwarded by .. W. Ouncan 〔此处转录不清〕

At 10 a.m. March 23 when a plain clothes French-
man of the C.M.F. attempted to inspect the hawker's licence
of a vegetable hawker on the footpath in front of house
No.1245 Avenue Haig, a Chinese policeman of the 6th District
Police Station intervened stating that no French Concession
licence was necessary as Avenue Haig was an extra-Settlement
thoroughfare and that the hawker was standing on the foot-
path. An altercation arose between the two parties and
the Chinese policeman, it is reported, drew his pistol
and attempted to take the Frenchman to the Station. Further
trouble was prevented by the arrival of a party of French
Police who succeeded in settling the dispute peacefully.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Comms.

报告
特别巡捕房分站 S.1，
日期 ____ 三月 __ 24 __ 日，34 年

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / C. 档案号登记簿 / 编号 D 5756 / 日期 24 / 3 / 34）

事由（全称） ____ 一名中国巡捕与法公董局（C.M.F.）一名法国雇员就租界外道路的管辖权发生争执。

制作人 .. 督察 .. 施子良（Sih Tse-liang） ____ 转呈人 .. W. Ouncan〔此处转录不清〕

3 月 23 日上午 10 时，一名身穿便服的法公董局法国人在海格路（Avenue Haig）1245 号门前人行道上试图检查一名蔬菜摊贩的执照时，第六区警察署的一名中国巡捕介入，声称海格路系租界外干道，无需法租界执照，且该摊贩站在人行道上。双方发生口角，据报，该名中国巡捕拔出手枪，并试图将该法国人带往警署。随后一批法国巡捕赶到，和平解决了争端，从而避免了进一步的冲突。

施子良（Sih Tse Liang）
督察

特别巡捕房主管警官。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, MARCH 25, 1934

FRENCH AND CHINESE
POLICE DISPUTE

Alleged Interference At
Siccawei To Be
Discussed Soon

Negotiations between the Shang-
hai City Government and French
Authorities regarding an alleged
dispute between police of the two
municipalities will be opened soon,
according to the vernacular press.
Complaints of merchants at Sicca-
wei Village have been received by
the Mayor's office and the mer-
chants have been advised to await
pending negotiations.
The "China Evening News"
states that on March 19 French
police objected to the presence of
Bureau of Public Safety men who
were on traffic duty at Siccawei.
Again on the Friday morning
French police were seen patrol-
ling Siccawei streets and driving
away stall-keepers, it is alleged.
The Chinese are said to have
objected strenuously to a French
detective in plain clothes who
entered Chinese-controlled terri-
tory on Friday.

（批：Jule 报）

《上海星期泰晤士报》，1934 年 3 月 25 日

法国与中国
巡捕争执

据称在徐家汇（Siccawei）的干涉行为
即将进行讨论

据中文报刊报道，上海市政府与法国当局之间就两市政机构巡捕之间据称发生的争执进行的谈判即将开始。市长办公室已收到徐家汇村（Siccawei Village）商人的投诉，并建议商人等待谈判结果。
《中国晚报》（China Evening News）称，3 月 19 日，法国巡捕对在徐家汇执行交通任务的公安局人员在场表示反对。据称，周五上午，又有人看到法国巡捕在徐家汇街道巡逻并驱赶摊贩。据说，中方对一名周五进入中方管辖区域的便衣法国侦探提出了强烈抗议。

（批：Jule 报）
